data.name: Waquar
data.gender_notes: Waquar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Waquar is a powerful Hindu name for boys, derived from the Sanskrit language. It means 'Ruler of the sky'. This name is inspired by the sun god, symbolizing power, strength, and authority. The name Waquar carries the meaning “Ruler of the sky” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Waquar usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Waquar is a name of the Sun God, Surya, who is considered the source of all life and energy. It represents the power of the universe and the strength of an individual's spirit.
data.etymology: Waquar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Waquar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
